hook.text: The label pulled out of an earlier agreement while the album was being recorded, and the print run shrank.

facts.label: Players
facts.value: Grzegorz Ciechowski (vocals, piano, moog), Sławomir Ciesielski (drums), Zbigniew Krzywański (electric guitar, vocals), Paweł Kuczyński (bass guitar)

sentences.text: The album was recorded at Wawrzyszew Sound Studio.
Grzegorz Ciechowski wrote the music and lyrics for eight of the nine tracks, and Zbigniew Krzywański shares the music on the ninth track, Obcy astronom.
The small run and the poor cover were caused by a change of director at Polton, and with it a change of company policy.
The case went to court, and the band lost it.
Reissues followed through the 1990s and 2000s, put out by MMPP, Sound-Pol and Pomaton EMI, and in 2003 the album was part of the Komplet set.
In 2002, Nieustanne tango, Psy Pawłowa and Obcy astronom were performed for the last time at a Kombinat concert dedicated to the late Grzegorz Ciechowski.

listen_for.text: Polton promoted this song abroad in 1985.
